item.tib: rtsa gsum bder gshegs 'dus pa'i rgyud las lung bstan snying gi rgya can
item.coloph: ces pa'i gsang lung snying gi rgya can 'di/ bon sgo 'di yi lung phog snying grogs pa/ ldong btsun sa trig sam sad blo yis bskul/ yang slob btsun chung g.yung drung phun tshogs kyis/ yang yang bskul zhing lha rdzas dri med dang / dar dkar gsang gos yug ring sna drangs te/ lus ngag yid gsum dad pas rab bskul nas/ de la brten nas rgya bon rigs grol ba/ snyigs dus skabs su bab pa'i ldong btsun pa/ tshe la dbang thob mu la sgon gsal gyis/ rjes su 'breng ba'i kho bo bde chen snying / gsang ba'i ming ni g.yung drung thog med rtsal/ wa skyes seng lpags gyon pa'i te (gte) rgan pa/ g.yung drung grags pa bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan ngas/ 'bo rgyal g.yung drung lha rtse'i mdun zhol du/ tshad gsum bka' la slad kyis ma gos par/ bstan 'gro'i don du zhu ba blo tshim chod/ yi ge ris su btab pa'i dge tshogs des/ bkra shis bon bstan rgyas pa'i rgyu gyur cig/
